lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Five distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, with a wider gap between the three central lines and narrower spacing between the two posterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The line second from the posterior terminates mid-flank before reaching the ventral boundary; the most anterior line is fragmented and terminates below the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of approximately 4-5 white spots is visible on the upper haunch area at the transition between the torso and the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the posterior haunch align horizontally.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white markings are visible on the muzzle and cheek, including a cluster of three spots arranged in a triangular pattern on the lower jaw area.
